cases.input: [app] First commute with MetroNest, and it was better than RailLoop. The app showed open seats before boarding, and the crowded 7:40 train still had a comfortable seat. My bag stayed secure, boarding was orderly, and we reached downtown without a delay. The trip felt reliable and easy to repeat.

[place] Brioche Lantern, Valebrook
[text] Mara, my fictional dining companion, joined me in memory as I took my day-off brunch alone at a booked table. A large group delayed the kitchen, so my eggs en cocotte and almond croissant arrived late. The server kept me updated—très bien—and comped coffee, though this visit felt less smooth than usual.
